# Debrief: Argo CD, cert-manager, Envoy, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Istio, Kubernetes

These clips give the team practical Argo CD guidance on structuring applications and previewing changes, plus context on Istio's architecture, cert-manager's Gateway API direction, and OpenTelemetry collector lessons. ([Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 16:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=1005s); [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 8:41](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=521s); [Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 4:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=264s); [Cert-manager – Project Update: Beyond 2026 · 7:44](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vzBGkY_HIyM&t=464s); [We Deleted Our Observability Stack and Rebuilt It With OTEL: 12 Engineers to 4 at 20K+ Clusters · 14:11](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0oum6Eh1is&t=851s))

## Top 3 takeaways

1. Writing many individual Argo CD Applications is called an anti-pattern; one ApplicationSet can replace dozens, for example five infrastructure apps across ten clusters, though complex setups need planning to categorize clusters. ([Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 16:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=1005s))
2. Argo CD pull request previews should run on a dedicated instance, not production, because the process creates and deletes applications repeatedly and can overload and crash the instance. Self-hosted runners can address security concerns. ([Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 8:41](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=521s))
3. The Ingress Nginx deprecation is pushing people toward Gateway API, and cert-manager's Gateway API integration dates to 2021. Teams using the cert-manager Ingress annotation should watch this. Ambient adopters also report needing Gateway API plugins for Argo Rollouts. ([Cert-manager – Project Update: Beyond 2026 · 7:44](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vzBGkY_HIyM&t=464s); [The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 21:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=1319s))

## Action items

- [ ] Audit your Argo CD repos for individual Application manifests repeated across clusters and prototype replacing them with a single ApplicationSet. ([Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 16:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=1005s))
- [ ] If you want PR change previews, stand up a dedicated Argo CD instance for that purpose rather than pointing the tool at production. ([Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 8:41](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=521s))
- [ ] Check which of your Ingress resources use the cert-manager annotation, and review what migrating toward Gateway API would involve for cert-manager. ([Cert-manager – Project Update: Beyond 2026 · 7:44](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vzBGkY_HIyM&t=464s))

## Watch together (9 min)

1. [Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 16:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=1005s) (1:22), Regina Voloshin: Concrete ApplicationSet advice that replaces many individual Argo CD Applications.
2. [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 8:41](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=521s) (2:21), Dag Bjerre Andersen, Sergey Shevchenko: Warns against previewing PRs on production Argo CD; suggests dedicated instance.
3. [Cert-manager – Project Update: Beyond 2026 · 7:44](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vzBGkY_HIyM&t=464s) (1:20), Tim Ramlot, Maël Valais: cert-manager and Gateway API implications of Ingress Nginx deprecation.
4. [The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 21:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=1319s) (1:21), Alfonso Ming, Jorge Turrado: Ambient mesh tradeoffs involving cert-manager, Argo Rollouts and Gateway API plugins.
5. [We Deleted Our Observability Stack and Rebuilt It With OTEL: 12 Engineers to 4 at 20K+ Clusters · 14:11](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0oum6Eh1is&t=851s) (2:24), Yash Sharma, Kunju Perath: OpenTelemetry collector processors and memory limiter lessons, with Prometheus config porting.
